title: User Delegation Configuration (FR-013)
description: Schema for the user delegation config (resolution: explicit path > $MANIFEST_CONFIG_DIR > ~/.claude/config/). Canonical files: delegation.json (parsed everywhere, stdlib) and delegation.yml (parsed when PyYAML is importable; a .yml present without PyYAML is reported as unreadable => factory defaults per FR-013; .json wins when both exist). Absent file => factory defaults (default_backend codex, all backends enabled, 600s budgets, gate off). Invalid file => report on stderr + factory defaults; the dispatcher MUST NOT crash on it and MUST NOT honor a partially-parsed broken config. Workspace services.yml disables outrank any enabled:true here. Unknown top-level or backend keys are reported and ignored. Setup writes delegation.json (the canonical setup-written format); YAML is written only when updating an existing delegation.yml with PyYAML confirmed importable — a .yml present without PyYAML is reported unreadable and delegation.json is written and takes precedence.

default_backend.description: Registry id or alias; a value not in the registry is rejected with the known-backend list (never guessed)

budget_seconds.description: Hard bound on the single gate pause (FR-006). Capped at 840s = Stop-hook timeout (900s) minus cleanup overhead; a larger configured value is capped and the cap is reported

backends.description: Keys are registry ids; entries for backends not in the registry are rejected by name with the known list

enabled.description: User-level toggle; workspace services.yml disable wins over enabled:true, and reports name the winning layer

model.description: Tier name (resolved via model_tiers when deployed config exists) or verbatim model string; null => registry default_tier (economical default per FR-009)
